Assess and prioritize technical debt in: <scope>

Base the assessment on current source/tests/issues, not generic preferences. Identify debt that causes measurable risk: bugs, security exposure, slow delivery, poor recoverability, duplicate logic, fragile tests, obsolete compatibility, or maintenance cost.

For each item give evidence, impact, urgency, dependency, and smallest improvement. Group into now/next/later and avoid proposing a rewrite unless incremental repair is genuinely impractical and justified.
